en-US.longDescription: SolidPing monitors HTTP(S) endpoints, TCP/UDP ports, DNS records, SSL certificates, ICMP ping and databases, with alerts over email, Slack, Discord, Telegram and webhooks, public status pages, and Uptime Kuma import. Single binary, SQLite by default.
